unlock_condition: Synthetic recovery passed for the exact frozen 85-unit two-way fixed-effect design.
execution_rule: Run the frozen dynamic association exactly once before any outcome-dependent change to exposure, roster, regions, time support, model, permutation scheme or sensitivity set.

primary.model: site FE + species-specific region x season FE + standardized exposure-change-rate x decade
primary.multiplicity: Holm across the three species tests

mandatory_sensitivities: repeat exposure with rate_p67_per_year using the same roster and model
precision-weighted refit using frozen collapsed observation variance
forbidden: change site eligibility after seeing beta
change APBP regional groups after seeing beta
change p50 to p67 as primary based on result
replace relative-use response with a different outcome after seeing result
